svg.title: Extended mountain: 24 jumps, ceiling holds, descending rebounds and yellow fall brakes (level SVG v1)

g.text: GRAPPLE OVER / EXTENDED ROUTE / BASELINE PRESERVED
Hold the ceiling. Drop. Bounce back up.
24 jumps · original 01–10 unchanged · four compound ceiling / descent / rebound sequences · six yellow braking bands
GRAPPLE RANGE 540u · percentages show minimum open gaps · every illustrated flight remains unverified with production physics
Yellow rectangles slow falls without providing a foothold, grapple target, checkpoint or automatic return.
All six stay ≥540u from solid geometry.
No nominal illustrated arc enters a band.
Grab a ceiling from below; release diagonally down onto a sloped green bounce surface; redirect into an upward jump.
Descending and ascending legs share the same bounce contact. No reset, teleport, extra launch force or hidden intermediate anchor is implied.
Yellow bands are horizontal, non-solid fall brakes. Falling continues through them into earlier terrain; recovery and damping remain unverified.
Geometric checks exclude direct fragment-to-fragment grappling. They do not establish viable jump physics, mandatory release or absence of swing bypasses.
Level SVG v1 conversion of extended-mountain.svg. Gameplay is in the geometry/markers layers; this layer is display only.
